<style>.rig-breathe{animation:rig-breathe 4.2s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes rig-breathe{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-2.71px)}}.rig-tail,.rig-ear{transform-box:view-box}.rig-tail{animation:rig-wag 1.6s ease-in-out -0.5s infinite}@keyframes rig-wag{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-12deg)}50%{transform:rotate(12deg)}}.feel-happy .rig-tail{animation:rig-happy 0.7s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes rig-happy{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-18deg)}50%{transform:rotate(18deg)}}.feel-sad .rig-tail{animation:rig-sad 3.2s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes rig-sad{0%,100%{transform:rotate(25deg)}50%{transform:rotate(22deg)}}.feel-afraid .rig-tail{animation:rig-afraid 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes rig-afraid{0%,100%{transform:rotate(40deg)}50%{transform:rotate(37.2deg)}}.feel-surprised .rig-tail{animation:none;transform:rotate(-15deg)}.rig-tail{transform-box:view-box;rotate:calc(var(--tail,0)*28deg)}.wagging .rig-tail{animation:none;transform:none}.rig-head{transform-box:view-box;rotate:calc(var(--head,0)*16deg)}.rig-legs{transform-box:view-box;scale:1 calc(1 - var(--low,0)*0.49)}.rig-breathe{translate:calc(var(--low,0)*0px) calc(var(--low,0)*70.06px)}.rig-arm{transform-box:view-box}.rig-arm-r{rotate:calc(clamp(-110, var(--ar,0), 110)*1deg)}.rig-arm-l{rotate:calc(clamp(-110, var(--al,0), 110)*1deg)}.rig-leg{transform-box:view-box}.on-walking .rig-leg-a{animation:rig-step 0.92s ease-in-out infinite}.on-walking .rig-leg-b{animation:rig-step 0.92s ease-in-out -0.46s infinite}@keyframes rig-step{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-22deg)}50%{transform:rotate(22deg)}}.rig-head{scale:1 calc(1 - clamp(0, var(--nod,0), 7)*0.0114)}</style></svg>
